description: Every option and price the tools accept, from the live constants: voices for a language (premium flag + extra credits), art styles (PRO flag), niches, caption themes, aspect ratios, the durations each tool allows, video providers for the plan, motion-clip / hero-scene prices — and for each, which tool lets you choose it. Use it instead of guessing an enum. clipPrices: every clip model and resolution that is switched on now; creditsPerSecond is the price THIS account pays (the charge's own function), with standardCreditsPerSecond, lowerCreditsPerSecond (null when none), priceClass and approxUsdPerSecond; clipPriceClass says which class applies, why and how an account becomes eligible for the lower one. usdPrices: the price in USD of every plan on sale (per month, with its monthly credits and USD per credit), of every one-time credit pack, and of your own plan. Free.
name: autoshort_list_options
title: List options and prices
